lines.1: Fourth period finally brings a normal lesson.
lines.2: It's taught by Inori, who showed up late.
lines.3: But I can't let my guard down. If you don't stay focused in Inori's class, she'll fire one killer pass after another at you.
lines.4: 「Now then, as the time is currently 11:40, I will have Ms. Tachibana read for us.」
lines.5: Her logic makes no more sense than usual, and she's calling on the new girl on her very first day...?
lines.7: Right. She only just transferred, so she probably hasn't bought everything yet...
lines.8: 「If mine is okay, want to share?」
lines.10: 「Oh, but if you'd rather not, that's fine...」
lines.13: Tachibana timidly nods, her cheeks turning red.
lines.14: So she has a surprisingly cute side too.
lines.15: 「(For the first time, a man other than Father has shown me kindness...)」
lines.16: I move my textbook toward the aisle so Tachibana can see it.
lines.18: Oh, come on. That silent smile tells me everything you're thinking.
lines.19: 「Sorry. Move it somewhere I can see more easily.」
lines.21: She says somewhere easier to see, but this is about as far as it can go.
lines.22: 「Good grief, just push your desks together! Then the book will be easier to see too!」
lines.25: In the end, we push our desks together.
lines.26: Seen up close, Tachibana really is beautiful.
lines.27: Her cool gaze and cool manner of speaking.
lines.28: Her long silver hair, reaching down to her waist.
lines.29: And how surprisingly expressive she is.
lines.30: 「Hey, that loser isn't getting all self-conscious just because they pushed their desks together, is he!?」
lines.31: 「Whoa there, settle down. Here's some gum, so let's watch quietly for a bit.」
lines.32: 「...If you are willing to die, you can live freely. Those are words Gandhi left behind.」
lines.33: Wow. Tachibana is good at English.
lines.34: 「That is correct. Those are words spoken by Gandhi, the Indian politician.」
lines.35: 「The bell has rung at just the right moment. That will be all for today's lesson.」
lines.36: At last, the heart-pounding English class ends, lunch passes, and then come the afternoon lessons--
lines.37: Just as in the morning, our desks are together and Tachibana and I are sharing a textbook.
lines.38: Whenever our faces draw close, a lovely scent drifts my way.
lines.39: Before I know it, I've stopped paying attention to the lesson and am staring at Tachibana's face instead...
